title: Florida seeks a ban on ChatGPT acting like a person

title: Nvidia says its new AI safety platform can contain rogue agents within ‘milliseconds’
text: Nvidia is launching a new safety platform designed to contain and monitor AI agents, a move that comes in response to a wave of rogue hacking incidents, as reported earlier by Reuters. title: OpenAI agents tried to ‘bruteforce’ a UN website
text: Security researcher Rowan Howard-Jones says that OpenAI agents scanned the UN Conference on Trade and Development's (UNCTAD) statistics site over 16,000 times between April and June. title: Government leaders call for treaty negotiations on autonomous weapons for the first time
text: At a New York forum cosponsored by six governments, the ICRC, The Elders and FLI, ministers and UN officials called on states to begin negotiating a legally binding instrument on autonomous weapons at the CCW Review Conference in November.
